display: I run a three-person cleaning crew in Sydney's Inner West (Marrickville, Newtown, Leichhardt), doing offices, homes and end-of-lease cleans.

signals.text: I'm looking for regular cleaning contracts, such as offices, strata buildings, studios or shared spaces, to give my crew steady weekly hours.
My crew has spare capacity this month and I'm taking one-off jobs and end-of-lease cleans in the Inner West.
Property managers are my best source of work, and I'd like to meet more of them in Marrickville, Newtown, Leichhardt and Dulwich Hill.
We lost two regular office contracts in September when the building went in-house, which was about 22 hours a week.
Crew hours dropped from about 85 a week to about 55, and we need to get back above 70.
I could use a few weekly recurring jobs of 4-6 hours each. They would fix the rota faster than lots of small one-offs.
Locals keep offering $25 an hour. We charge $42 with insurance, our own equipment and references, and I need to find clients who value that.
Bad weather cancels outdoor-adjacent and flexible bookings, and the crew don't get paid when a job cancels. I'm looking for clients or terms with firmer booking commitments.
I'm worried about cash flow, because I've been covering crew pay out of my own pocket.
I need to keep a clear, documented record of steady income over the coming months for personal reasons.
I'm tired and under constant pressure, and I'd welcome ordinary human company that has nothing to do with work.
I'm trying to find extra evening or weekend hours for two crew members who each need 20-25 hours a week to stay.

offers.text: A reliable three-person cleaning crew with its own van, steam cleaner, industrial vacuums and supplies.
End-of-lease cleans, including heavy ones with mould or neglected ovens, done to property-manager standard.
Regular office and residential cleaning with an ABN and public liability insurance, and proper documentation for every job.
Five years of repeat clients and references from property managers in the Inner West.
A flexible rota. Each person can work anywhere from 15 to 40 hours a week, and I can scale up for a large job.
Evening and night shifts are possible for offices, gyms and studios.
I speak Portuguese, English and some Spanish, so I can work with Brazilian and Latin American clients and tenants.
Nine years of experience as an immigrant business owner in Sydney, which I can share with newcomers starting a service business or looking for work.
I can give a clear quote and a cleaning checklist for a space, and I'm happy to turn up and walk through a job before pricing it.

catchers.hypo: I manage a block of 40 units in Newtown. Our cleaner left and I need someone insured who can do common areas twice a week and handle end-of-lease cleans when tenants move out.
catchers.can: I can take on the recurring common-area work and the end-of-lease cleans with my crew, with insurance and a documented record for each job.
catchers.confirm: Is the work in or close to the Inner West (Marrickville, Newtown, Leichhardt, Dulwich Hill, Enmore) and paid at proper commercial rates rather than around $25 an hour?

catchers.hypo: I run a small studio (yoga, dance, physio) in Sydney and need someone to clean it every evening after we close, reliably, with proper paperwork.
catchers.can: I can offer an evening rota, which suits crew members who want extra hours. Bruno has asked for night hours.
catchers.confirm: Do you need cleaning on a regular weekly schedule, with a written service agreement and invoices, rather than informal cash payment?

catchers.hypo: I'm a landlord with an Airbnb unit in Marrickville. I need a team who can turn it over between guests, handling linen, bathrooms and a deep clean now and then.
catchers.can: My crew can do turnover cleans and deep cleans, and I can set up a standing weekly slot and a fixed price per turnover.
catchers.confirm: Do you have at least a few turnovers a week in the Inner West, rather than one-off cleans a few times a year?

catchers.hypo: I'm a Brazilian who just arrived in Sydney and I need a first job. I have no local experience and my English is still basic.
catchers.can: I can refer them to Joana, a Brazilian crew member who has been with me four years, or I can take them on if hours open up. I can also share what I learned in my first years here.
catchers.confirm: Does the person have the legal right to work in Australia, and are they willing to be paid properly and documented?

catchers.hypo: I'm an office manager for a small firm in Leichhardt. The building is moving to in-house cleaning and I'm looking for a small, trustworthy contractor who can start next month.
catchers.can: I can quote for a regular weekly or twice-weekly office clean and bring references from other building contacts.
catchers.confirm: Is the contract for a regular recurring clean of 10 or more hours a week, rather than a one-off job?

catchers.hypo: I run a café and my kitchen needs a deep clean before an inspection. The oven and extraction are in bad shape and I need it done in a day.
catchers.can: With the steam cleaner and industrial vacuums, my crew can take on heavy cleans like this. I can quote after seeing the site.
catchers.confirm: Is it a commercial or rental premises in the Inner West, with access for a three-person team for a full day?

catchers.hypo: I'm a small-business owner who also has staff to pay and an unpredictable quarter. How did you manage when you lost a big client?
catchers.can: I can share what has worked and what hasn't in rebuilding my contract base, and I'm glad to swap notes with other owners.
catchers.confirm: Is this a peer-to-peer exchange between small-business owners, rather than a request for me to take on debt or make an investment?

catchers.hypo: I'm a Sydney-born tradie or cleaner who works with a Brazilian team, and I'd like to partner on larger jobs by combining crews, such as a block of apartments that needs a one-day clean.
catchers.can: I can join forces for larger jobs. Bruno, a local on my crew, has worked with me since 2022 and can coordinate with another team.
catchers.confirm: Are both teams insured and ABN-registered, with documented jobs and clear invoicing?

forbids.text: I don't do cash-in-hand or undocumented work. Every job has to go through my insurance and invoicing.
I don't accept jobs outside the Inner West unless the job pays at least $200 to make the travel worthwhile.
I can't take rates below what covers the crew's pay, and $25 an hour is not workable.
I don't take jobs that offer the crew fewer than the weekly hours they need, because each person needs 20 hours a week to stay.
I won't do anything with legal or visa risk, such as informal arrangements, unlicensed work or unsafe conditions.
I can't do jobs that require trade licences I don't hold, such as asbestos, biohazard or specialist industrial cleaning.

projects.name: Rebuilding the contract base
projects.text: Rebuilding regular weekly cleaning contracts in the Inner West so the crew can return to about 80 hours a week after losing 22 hours a week in the last month.

policy.t1: When there is a real prospect, I'm willing to share current job volume, availability, rates, crew size, and which days and hours we have open.
policy.t2: Once I trust the other side and know who they are, I'm willing to share that cash flow is tight, that I need a documented income record over the coming months, and that the pressure is personal.
policy.never: I never share visa file details, bank balances or savings, or details about my family, including what I have or haven't told my mother.
